description: This PHP class defines an 'EmergencyContact' display field for reporting within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a listable display field and specifies DTO class, entity alias, and associated fields for use in reports.

classes.name: EmergencyContact
classes.description: A class representing the display field for emergency contacts in reports, extending ListableDisplayField and specifying DTO, aliases, and fields relevant to emergency contact information.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields that this display field represents.
